xaalisi.title: Xaalisi - Financial Infrastructure & National Neo-Bank
xaalisi.role: Lead Full-Stack Developer — XAALISI (Paid Internship - FAMIB Group)
xaalisi.description:
Design and development from scratch of a national neo-bank. As Lead Developer over a 6-month period, I architected and deployed a complete, secure, and scalable FinTech solution.

Frontend & Mobile: Development of the Web administration interface and the cross-platform mobile application (React Native) with a conversion-optimized UX/UI.

Backend & Core Banking: Implementation of a RESTful API (FastAPI) connected to PostgreSQL. Design of an ACID transaction engine preventing double-spending via idempotency keys.

FinTech Features: Integration of multi-channel payments (USSD, Tontines, QR Code) and identity validation (KYC) using OCR technology.

Ops & Architecture: Software lifecycle management via a Monorepo and Microservices architecture. Production deployment on a cloud server (Docker, Nginx, Let's Encrypt).

bdanow.title: BDANOW - Centralized Web Platform
bdanow.description:
Academic Context
End-of-studies project carried out as part of my Bachelor's degree in Marketing & Digital Transformation at FSJES Souissi. Developed for the Digital Projects Management and Marketing module, under the supervision of Professor Mustapha ASBAI.

The Project
BDANOW is a digital "one-stop shop" designed to solve the fragmentation of information in the Moroccan training market, directly connecting learners to training centers.

My Role: Project Manager & Web Developer
Combining my hybrid profile (Marketing / Dev), I managed this project from A to Z:
- Management & Strategy: Coordination of a 9-person team, drafting specifications, creating visual identity, and developing the marketing strategy.
- Development: UI/UX design, front-end architecture programming, and platform deployment.

wordpress.title: Shop Digital - Digital Agency & E-commerce
wordpress.description:
Description:
End-to-end design and development of "Shop Digital", a hybrid website combining a digital agency showcase and an e-commerce solution (WooCommerce). This project was designed to offer a fluid user experience (UX) and optimize the conversion of online digital services.

Key Features and Achievements:
- Development of a modern, responsive, and user-oriented interface.
- Integration and configuration of an online store for selling e-services.
- Implementation of dynamic contact forms for lead generation.
- Overall optimization of the site to combine technical performance and digital marketing objectives.

indh.title: INDH Web Project (1st National Prize)
indh.description: Full Stack design and development of an interactive web platform dedicated to celebrating the 20th anniversary of the INDH.
